entities.summary: The Accademia Filarmonica Romana is a musical institution based in Rome, Italy. It was established in 1821 by a group of upper class amateur musicians led by the Marquis Raffaele Muti Papazzurri (1801–1858) in order to encourage the performance of chamber music and symphony, and to perform in concert operas whose representation was hampered by censorship. Accademia Filarmonica Romana is a archives from Europe. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
